## Fixes

- Fixed the seed-track search results' audio preview being unreliable: it now relies on Deezer's public search endpoint instead of the undocumented `artist:`/`track:` query syntax, which Deezer had silently broken and was causing most previews to fail to load.
- The "Preview" button on seed-track search results is now available immediately when results appear, instead of only after hovering over a result.

## Upgrade notes

- No action required. Existing settings, favorites and playlist data carry over automatically.
